name: Anyang
scopeLimits: The ranked UN World Urbanization Prospects 2025 population-weighted locator is not a municipal boundary or parcel identity. Official local registration/land-record evidence was found, but no anonymous public parcel polygon was verified for this locator. No full geometry or owner/address data is retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official Anyang municipal procurement information identifies a city Real Estate Transaction and Registration Center. This confirms a local registration authority, not public access to parcel geometry.
technicalBlocker: No city-specific parcel vector service was exposed by the inspected official public map viewer. Public geometry remains unverified.
remainingUncertainty: Whether a separate authenticated or non-public cadastral interface exists, and whether any untraced public layer covers the WUP locator.
nextStep: If needed, ask the municipal registry or Natural Resources and Planning Bureau for an open parcel-data service or public query interface; do not infer geometry from the city basemap.

viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: Static HTML, map page, configuration and main JavaScript bundle for the official Anyang Tianditu viewer were inspected.
